title: Port as a number
statement:
Print the port of the database as a number.

In the input the port is a string. The first step takes `port`. The second step is `.`, which changes nothing. Replace the second step with `tonumber`.

title: What comes out?
statement:
Type what jq prints for this input and this filter.

You may type it on one line. Spaces and line breaks do not matter.

title: The next attempt
statement:
Print the number of the next attempt, as a number.

The current attempt is in `attempt`. It is a string. The next attempt is one more.
